main.subtitle: Weblings Streamline
main.title:
Lean, AI-driven project management.
Zero bloat—turn client meetings directly into tickets and cut out the middleman.
main.content: Streamline gives you a bloat-free, AI-supercharged board where client calls instantly become tickets. With native Team Chat integration and free external guest access, you get all the power without the frustrating learning curve or the hidden costs.

features.subtitle: The End of Manual Ticket Entry
features.title: Automated Scope-to-Sprint Pipeline
content: When a client drops a new requirement during a call, nobody has to scramble to type it out. The AI catches it, drafts the exact ticket, and queues it for your approval. A completely automated workflow with just a single click of human verification.
• Smart Detection: The AI listens to the live meeting, cross-references your project baseline, and extracts brand new client requirements automatically.
• Human Verification: You review the AI-generated ticket summary. Click approve to register it as a formal Change of Request without typing a single word.
• Instant Integration: The approved ticket instantly drops into the active sprint backlog, assigns itself to the right developer, and pings the team in Chat.

features.subtitle: Intelligent Discovery
features.title: Semantic Vector Search: Find Needles in a Haystack
content: Don't remember the exact keyword you typed three months ago? It doesn't matter. Search through thousands of tickets using natural human language.
• Contextual Matching: The AI understands the context and meaning of your request, instantly pulling up the exact ticket, attachment, and comment history you need without relying on rigid tags.
• Millisecond Retrieval: Instantly locate specific bug descriptions, client feedback snippets, or code references across all historical sprints.

features.subtitle: Absolute Accountability
features.title: The Immutable Audit Trail
content: Every comment, attachment, and status change is permanently recorded. You always know exactly who changed a ticket's priority, who reassigned it, and when it happened.
• Real-Time Transparency: No invisible edits or covering tracks—just absolute accountability and complete lifecycle transparency across every sprint.
• Comprehensive Log: Clear timestamps and author attribution for all file attachments, status transitions, and priority revisions.

features.subtitle: Unified Mobile Experience
features.title: Your Team, In Your Pocket.
content: Available on both iOS and Android. Review client comments, transition tickets across columns, and track sprint progress while waiting in line for coffee. Your agile board is always perfectly in sync.

usage.subtitle: Enterprise Architecture
usage.title: Enterprise Architecture, Minus the Clutter.
usage.description: Everything you need to run agile sprints at scale, built intuitively so your team doesn't need a manual to figure it out.

cards.title: 1-Click Bulk Reassignment
cards.description: Employee resigned? Don't waste hours clicking through 50 open tickets manually. Instantly transfer an offboarded employee's entire workload to a new assignee with a single click.

cards.title: Free External Guest Access
cards.description: Need a freelancer to fix a bug or a client to approve a design? Invite external users via email to specific boards. They can view and comment without requiring you to pay for an extra seat.

cards.title: Custom Workflow Configuration
cards.description: Build the board exactly how you work. Create organization-wide or project-specific statuses and custom ticket types to perfectly match different client requirements or internal workflows.

cards.title: Epic & Story Hierarchy
cards.description: Organize complex projects intuitively. Group sub-tasks under Stories, roll Stories into Epics, and manage Sprint backlogs cleanly. Unfinished tickets automatically roll over when a Sprint concludes.

demo.description: Watch how modern engineering and product teams streamline sprint planning, convert meeting action items into tickets automatically, and accelerate deliveries.
